assessments.reasoning: The dated W3C XPath 3.1 Recommendation was reacquired at the registered digest. §3.11.2.1 defines an array as associating positive integer positions with values and assigns integer 1 to the first position. It defines stored values as members.

challenge.method: Compare the empty array case with the square constructor example containing two entries where one member is an empty sequence. Check the neighboring curly constructor rule for converting operand items into members.
challenge.results: The empty array has no first member. A square array containing an empty sequence and a multi-item sequence has two members under the explicit example. Negative and zero positions are excluded by the definition.

limitations: The rule concerns positions in XPath arrays. Sequence items within a member do not renumber the members.
